## DotOS v0.2.3

Battery and quiet-hours controls, plus a round of home-screen polish.

### New
- **Night time** (Settings > Night time) — quiet hours you choose, in 30-minute
  steps (they can cross midnight). While active the watch does not vibrate and a
  new notification does not light up the screen. Notifications still wait in the
  list. Your alarms still ring and vibrate, and so does Find.
- **Battery menu** (Settings > Battery) — one place for every battery option,
  each explained in plain words: **Auto turn off display**, **Battery longevity**,
  and the automatic low-battery saver.
- **Auto turn off display** — the screen turns completely black 1 minute after it
  dims, if you have not touched the watch. Any touch restarts the minute.

### Changes
- The home-screen **battery gauge is now a row of dots**, matching the Dot face.
- The **notification banner border** and the **USB-charge animation** now follow
  the accent colour you pick in Facewatch.
- The Facewatch **pale steel-blue accent is gone** (too close to Grey). A watch
  that had it selected falls back to Grey.
- Menu > **Notifications** is plain white like the other rows.

### Fixes
- The home-screen **notification square is easier to tap**: its touch area is
  larger than the square you see.

### Flashing
New to DotOS? Start with the **[Installation guide](https://github.com/Holrigue/ARGUS-DotOS/blob/main/INSTALL.md)**.
Otherwise open **`DotOS-v0.2.3-flasher.html`** below in Chrome or Edge, plug the
watch in over USB-C, hold **BOOT** while connecting, and click **Flash**. Decline
the full erase to keep your settings.

Pairs with the **DotOS Dashboard 1.4** companion app (notification app filter, GPX
route picker).
